title: DerivedRelation
description: A normalized, qualified, defeasible proposition connecting two DerivedEntity objects: r = ⟨source, predicate, target, polarity, qualifiers⟩. In the transfer representation, polarity is carried as a mandatory `polarity` qualifier, but it is a distinguished component of the identity key, not one truth-conditional dimension among others. A DerivedRelation is NOT domain truth; it is a proposition whose evidential state is computed from RelationEvidence under a grounding profile and time. IDENTITY: the minimum identity key is Key(r) = ⟨sourceEntityId, predicate, targetEntityId, polarity, truth-conditional qualifiers⟩. Automatic merging is permitted only when source, predicate, target, and polarity are equivalent, all identity-relevant qualifiers are equivalent, and no identity-relevant qualifier is `unknown`. A DerivedRelation MUST NOT carry a copied authoritative source-state interval; temporal state is derived, not stored.

id.description: Opaque, unique identifier for this relation.

predicate.description: The predicate connecting source to target. The specific vocabulary is profile-defined; see `predicateFamily` for the coarse classification.

qualifiers.description: A map from qualifier dimension name to its RelationQualifier. Each property key SHOULD equal the value's `dimension`. Every well-formed relation MUST include a `polarity` qualifier. Any identity-relevant qualifier with status `unknown` blocks automatic merging.

reviewStatus.description: Curation lifecycle status of this relation. Distinct from evidential state: `accepted` is not `supported`.

predicateFamily.description: Coarse classification of the predicate. The base specification recognizes: classificatory, definitional, normativeDependency (deontic dependency), institutional, procedural, factualCausal, attributional, normativeConsequential.

canonicalLabel.description: Optional human-readable rendering of the proposition. Display only.

description.description: Optional prose description of the proposition.
